original.statement: Loki adds support for per-tenant configuration of how OTLP data is mapped to the Loki format.

decision.reason: [ev-edfb2e66c4df] lists this under 3.0.0 Features as new support for per-tenant configuration of how OTLP data is mapped to the Loki format, so "added" is the right change type. The excerpt does not name a config key, Helm value or component. That makes a free-form protocol-behavior subject built from the evidence's own words ("otlp-per-tenant-mapping") a reasonable identity. The validators were inconclusive, and choosing this family over an unnamed config-key is a judgement call, so confidence is low.
